meta.title: Notebook
meta.description: An experience notebook for the model: read before work, write before wrapping up. Keeps one universal notebook and one per-project notebook, projected into managed blocks inside agent.md and project_agent.md so the harness instruction loader reads them into context, and queues a maintenance reminder into the session every N turns. How to use it: open 备忘录 in the sidebar; on the first visit a non-blocking three-minute guide floats at the bottom right, and ticking 「以后不再提醒」 stops it for good while the 使用说明 button in the footer brings it back. Set 项目根 to the directory that holds your projects (for example D:\projects) and press Enter to save it to $DSH_HOME/notebook/config.json; it only feeds the picker. Then choose a project from the dropdown or type its absolute path, and switch it on so the two projections get written. Each card is one entry: 确立 entries carry their full text into the injected context, 候选 keep only a title, 退役 only stay in the index. The page also edits entries, sets the cadence, lists the sessions that belong to the project, and builds a self-review prompt. The /notebook command accepts status, on, off, every N, review and sync. Data stays local: $DSH_HOME/notebook/universal.json plus 项目/.dsh-notebook/notebook.json, with the two markdown projections written at the project root; nothing is uploaded and no network is used. Switching it off removes both managed blocks and keeps the JSON, so re-enabling restores them. It injects one user-role reminder message (source.plugin=dsh-notebook) into the session and otherwise leaves the model context alone.
